text_block_list.text:
Seeing the overwhelming power of Grass 
Wonder, hailed as the strongest of the 
generation, Special Week was left 
completely crushed.

As she pushes herself to recklessness out 
of sheer frustration, her Trainer puts 
their own body on the line to stop her.

Remembering the path she had walked so 
far, Special Week regains her confidence 
and heads into the Arima Kinen with a 
renewed spirit.
